title: SG-8.2 Contribution textarea input validation
summary: Validate the contribution textarea: blank, max length with counter, zero quota
description: Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) only silently ignores an empty trimmed prompt, has no maximum length or counter, and still allows submit when remaining is 0. Desired behavior: block blank/whitespace-only text, enforce a max length with a visible counter and inline message, and block submit at zero quota with a clear message. Expected result: invalid input never reaches submitContribution and the player sees why. Why: clear feedback and fewer wasted backend calls.
acceptance_criteria: Given empty or whitespace-only text, when the player tries to submit, then no request is sent and an inline message is shown
Given text over the maximum length, when shown, then the counter and an inline message indicate the overflow and submit is blocked
Given remaining quota is 0, when the sheet is open, then submit is blocked and a clear message is shown

in_scope: ContributionSheet textarea validation, counter, inline messages, quota gating

definition_of_done: All three requirements delivered with passing unit tests
non_functional: Messages are exposed to assistive tech via role or aria-describedby
